sheet_prompt:
One illustration of 9 separate characters arranged in 3 rows of 3, evenly spaced across a single seamless background.
Subject: a small superhero figure wearing a red cape and mask standing on sand.
Style: glossy 3D render, smooth rounded shapes, shiny plastic-like material, soft studio lighting with bright reflections.
Outline: none. Draw every character directly on the background with no outline, border, stroke, die-cut edge or halo around it.
Reading left to right, top to bottom, every character is a different moment: a wide range of emotions AND different states of action (standing, walking, running, jumping, sitting, lying down, leaning, reaching, spinning), so no two characters share a pose, a body position or a silhouette:
Character 1: hero stands tall with cape flowing wide in the hot sun of Dubai
Character 2: hero jumps high into the air doing a backflip with cape trailing
Character 3: hero leans forward shouting with one arm stretched toward distant skyscrapers
Character 4: hero sits on a rock looking bored with cape draped over knees slowly
Character 5: hero spins rapidly in a circle with cape creating a big blur around body
Character 6: hero lies flat on stomach staring up at blue sky with arms by head
Character 7: hero kneels with hands on knees looking worried and frowning deeply
Character 8: hero laughs loud with hands covering mouth standing in a happy pose
Character 9: hero runs fast on one leg with cape flapping wildly behind like wind
Make every expression big and readable at small size: exaggerated eyes, eyebrows, mouth and body language.
Consistency: the same character design, proportions and colours for all 9 characters.
Background: a single, seamless, solid pure green (#00FF00) background covering the whole image in exactly one shade, with no tiled panels, no shading variations, no tint, gradient, vignette or glow, no shadows, no floor, no noise.
Spacing: every character is full body with a generous empty margin on every side (at least 20% of its own size), clearly separated from the others, none touching or crossing another.
video_prompt:
Animate this illustration sheet as a 3-second clip. Every character performs its own big, highly expressive, cartoon-style animation in place, inside its own cell, showing a wide range of emotions:
1. the hero shifts feet slightly while keeping arms relaxed at sides
2. the hero rotates backward mid-air before landing softly on feet
3. the hero bends at the waist and pushes chest out to yell loudly
4. the hero shifts weight from one leg to the other lazily
5. the hero circles fast on feet keeping hands near hips tightly
6. the hero rolls slightly onto side then back to lying position gently
7. the hero rocks back and forth while keeping head bowed low
8. the hero bends knees and hops excitedly while shaking shoulders
9. the hero strides forward quickly lifting opposite knee high each step
Animation style: wide emotions, highly expressive faces and bodies, exaggerated squash and stretch, anticipation and follow-through, clear facial animation (eyes, eyebrows, mouth), secondary motion on ears, tails and props, each character on its own rhythm, lively and full of personality. Never a static pose and never only a gentle sway.
Keep every character inside its own slot of the 3x3 layout; nothing may touch or cross a slot edge, and characters never interact with one another.
Empty slots stay empty: do not add any character, object or effect to them.
Static camera, no zoom, no pan, no cuts. Keep the one flat pure green (#00FF00) background exactly as it is, the same shade everywhere: no shadows, no gradient, no noise, no glow.
Keep each character's design, proportions and colours unchanged and do not add outlines or borders.
